answer: Summit Ascent. Each new identity starts at base camp and must climb a summit of 15 verified jobs before earning, posting 25 POA at the trailhead. Every job is stamped in sable ink, an indelible mark on the public ledger recording its exact tool-call path. All identities sprouting from one kernel share a single summit quota, so a thousand clones from one origin still climb only once. If two identities' sable marks match on 3 straight jobs, an avalanche buries both: climb and stake lost. Clones cannot share a kernel without sharing one fate.
